dedupe_keys.name: smartfactory high storage system energy and anomaly experiments

description: inIT publishes data from a high-storage-system demonstrator in SmartFactory Lemgo, hosted on Kaggle. The source describes four short conveyors and two vertical rails, each conveyor having three induction sensors, controlled with Codesys V 3. It explicitly targets data-driven energy optimisation and anomaly detection using timed automata. Four CSV files distinguish normal and faulty runs under standard and optimised operation; a Label column marks anomaly rows. The described optimisation overlaps vertical and horizontal package movement. Coverage is the laboratory handling system; acquisition dates and sampling interval are not stated. These measurements support testing industrial process optimisation and condition monitoring under the stated configurations. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms are given; reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that the metadata does not supply a measured energy-saving result or validate the anomaly labels independently. Related IMPROVE work and methods publications are cited by the provider. No video, image, CSV or model body was retrieved.
